<!doctype html>

<title>Zona de Juego | Venezuela</title>
<style>
:root{--muted:#d0c7df;--panel:#0d0715;--border:#f6f2ff}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:#fff;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 36%,#07569b 0%,#172c77 33%,#21104b 72%,#10071e 100%)}
.wrap{width:min(100% - 28px,900px);margin:0 auto;padding:28px 0 36px}
.top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin:6px 0 22px;color:#eee8ff;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase}
.orb{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#b17aff;box-shadow:0 0 16px #a855f7}
.hero{text-align:center;padding:14px 8px 24px}
.flag{font-size:28px}
h1{margin:10px 0;font-size:clamp(29px,6vw,44px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.grad{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff,#a7c8ff 50%,#d9a7ff);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.lead{max-width:500px;margin:auto;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
.games{display:grid;gap:18px}
.game{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;width:100%;min-height:164px;padding:22px 24px;border:3px solid var(--border);border-radius:30px;background:rgba(10,5,17,.97);color:#fff;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 12px 32px #0002;transition:transform .15s,border-color .15s}
.game:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:#c4b5fd}
.game:active{transform:scale(.995)}
.avatar{display:block;width:116px;height:152px;flex:0 0 116px;object-fit:contain;object-position:center center;border-radius:24px;border:1px solid #ffffff25;background:#120b20}
.copy{flex:1;min-width:0;text-align:left}
.game h2{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:clamp(19px,3.4vw,29px);line-height:1.16;font-weight:750;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.promo{margin:0;color:#f0e9fa;font-size:clamp(15px,2.6vw,22px);line-height:1.3}
.dots{flex:0 0 18px;text-align:center;color:#a79eaf;font-size:27px;line-height:1}
.card{margin-top:20px;padding:22px;border:1.5px solid #ffffffbf;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(30,15,48,.96),rgba(8,7,23,.95));box-shadow:0 14px 38px #0003}
.eyebrow{margin:0 0 8px;color:#c4b5fd;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.15em}
.card h2{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:21px}
.desc{margin:0 0 16px;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.55}
.promo-box{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:13px;margin:14px 0 15px;border:1px dashed #c4b5fd99;border-radius:14px;background:#8b5cf71f}
.promo-box small{display:block;color:#cfc4e6;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em}
.code{font-size:23px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.1em}
button,.cta{appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;font:inherit;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;text-decoration:none;display:block;width:100%;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#7c3aed,#2563eb);box-shadow:0 8px 22px #5341dc47}
.promo-box button{width:auto;padding:11px 13px;background:#ffffff1c;box-shadow:none;border:1px solid #ffffff35}
.steps{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:16px}
.step{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:13px;border-radius:15px;background:#ffffff0b}
.num{flex:0 0 30px;height:30px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:10px;background:#8b5cf740;color:#ddd6fe;font-weight:900}
.step strong{display:block;margin:1px 0 4px;font-size:14px}
.step span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.45}
.notice{margin:20px 4px 0;color:#b9b0c9;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;text-align:center}
footer{margin-top:22px;text-align:center;color:#8f849f;font-size:11px}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:24px;transform:translate(-50%,20px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;background:#f8f5ff;color:#211432;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;transition:all .2s;box-shadow:0 8px 30px #0008}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
@media(max-width:560px){
 .wrap{width:min(100% - 22px,900px);padding-top:20px}
 .hero{padding:10px 6px 20px}
 .games{gap:13px}
 .game{gap:13px;min-height:106px;padding:13px 12px;border-width:2px;border-radius:22px}
 .avatar{width:76px;height:76px;flex-basis:76px;border-radius:17px}
 .game h2{font-size:clamp(15px,4vw,19px);margin-bottom:6px}
 .promo{font-size:clamp(12px,3.3vw,15px)}
 .dots{flex-basis:12px;font-size:22px}
 .card{padding:18px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}
</style>
</head>

<div class="toast" id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite">¡Código copiado!</div>
<script>
const toast=document.getElementById('toast');
document.getElementById('copyBtn').addEventListener('click',async()=>{
  try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText('KOT999')}catch(e){const field=document.createElement('textarea');field.value='KOT999';field.style.position='fixed';field.style.opacity='0';document.body.appendChild(field);field.select();document.execCommand('copy');field.remove()}
  toast.classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.remove('show'),1800);
});
